old_description: From our Product Line to our Big Build Program we utilize our creative eye for Automotive Design to dial in 3d-models. Virtual rendering gives you a first hand look at the concept before we began fabrication...  Even the finish work we take care of in house, Powdercoating, Paint, Upholstery etc..
about:
Mop Top Pros operates from Mandan, North Dakota, where it was established by a group of automotive enthusiasts. The company describes itself as "car guys through and through," focused on building custom vehicles and composite parts that benefit the client or market.

The company designs and manufactures a line of composite automotive components, including hand-laid FRP and infused carbon-fiber parts such as dash panels, wide-body kits, grilles, and diffusers for platforms like the Nissan S14, Chevrolet Corvette C6, and Nissan R35. Through its Big Builds program, Mop Top Pros completes full custom vehicle projects—examples include a Mitsubishi EVO-X, a Chevrolet Corvette C6, and a Chevrolet C-10—handling 3D modeling, virtual rendering, fabrication, and in-house finishing such as powder coating, paint, and upholstery.

Mop Top Pros serves the automotive aftermarket and custom-car enthusiast market, supplying composite parts directly to owners and shops building track or show vehicles. Its Big Builds program targets owners of platforms such as the Mitsubishi EVO, Chevrolet Corvette, and Chevrolet C-10 who want a turnkey custom build with selectable options.

The founder emphasizes an imaginative design approach and fabrication precision to create vehicles that stand out while maintaining performance. The Big Builds program is positioned as offering faster turnaround and lower cost than traditional custom builds while still allowing customer-selected options.

old_description: The Motherson Group is a globally operating supplier providing full system solutions to the automotive industry, from design, simulation and prototyping to tooling, moulding, painting and final assembly of highly integrated modules. about:
Samvardhana Motherson Reflectec (SMR) operates its North American hub in Warren, Michigan, as part of the Motherson Group founded in 1975. The group grew into one of the 22 largest automotive suppliers worldwide, though the INPUT does not specify the ownership structure or individual founders.

SMR develops and manufactures rear-view mirror systems and intelligent camera technologies for automakers. Its manufacturing portfolio spans design, simulation, prototyping, tooling, moulding, painting and final assembly of integrated modules, from simple plastic components to complex assemblies with surfaces and embedded electrical functions. The company employs more than 10,400 people globally and holds a 24 percent share of the worldwide exterior-mirror market.

The division supplies nearly every major automotive manufacturer across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia, providing interior and exterior mirrors as well as camera-based environment sensors.

SMR states its mission as delivering "perfect vision while driving with a maximum of safety and comfort," positioning its mirror and camera systems as safety-critical technologies.

name: Motion Lite | Baton Rouge Technology Solutions
old_description: Yes! Our team specializes in integrating new equipment and solutions with existing infrastructure. We work to minimize disruption and ensure seamless integration with your current setup.
about:
Motion Lite operates from a shop on O’Neal Lane in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. The company was founded in 2020 by Gabriel Huggins, who had been working in the low‑voltage trade since 2015. Huggins holds a Louisiana contractor license (#77424), is a BICSI member, and has completed OSHA 30 construction safety training.

The firm provides a full suite of low‑voltage and technology services: structured cabling (Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6A, and fiber optic), IP security camera systems with NVR/DVR recording up to 4K resolution, night vision, thermal imaging, and remote access; AV integration including TV matrix switching, distributed audio, digital signage, LED video walls, and conference‑room technology for Teams and Zoom; access‑control systems using key fobs, card readers, biometrics, and mobile credentials; IT deployment of monitor arms, docks, and peripherals; and custom PC builds for gaming, professional workstations, and business use, with options for bring‑your‑own‑parts assembly and bulk office orders. The team has completed more than 250 projects across Louisiana and neighboring states.

Motion Lite serves commercial clients in offices, restaurants, schools, warehouses, and distribution centers, as well as bars, churches, and healthcare facilities requiring HIPAA‑compliant infrastructure. Recent work includes an 80‑camera Cisco Meraki deployment with outdoor Wi‑Fi at a distribution center in Walker, a 40‑drop network with six access points and a sound system for a Baton Rouge business, and an eight‑panel LED video wall for a restaurant in Lafayette. The company covers the Baton Rouge metro area — Denham Springs, Gonzales, Hammond — and travels to New Orleans, Lafayette, and Shreveport; for warehouse and distribution projects it works across Louisiana, Texas, Arkansas, Mississippi, Alabama, and Florida.

The company emphasizes a single‑contractor model that eliminates the need to coordinate separate cabling, security, AV, and access‑control vendors. It promotes honest pricing, long‑term support after installation, and the technical rigor that comes from BICSI membership and OSHA 30 training.

name: Mountain Drivetrain LLC
old_description: We offer repair and custom fabrication of drivelines from each of our shops in Wyoming and Washington state. We service off-road, light & heavy duty trucks, marine, oilfield and agricultural industries.
about:
Mountain Drivetrain LLC operates driveline service shops in Riverton, Wyoming and Centralia, Washington. The company is an owner-operated driveline shop specializing in repair, replacement, and custom fabrication of drivelines.

The shop provides driveline repair, replacement, and custom fabrication for one-, two-, and three-piece drivelines in aluminum or steel, metric and standard sizes. Services include re-tubing, U-joint installation, component replacement, precision spin balancing, and constant-velocity (CV) joint repair. The company also distributes driveline and PTO parts, maintaining an extensive inventory for light- and heavy-duty trucks, industrial, marine, and agricultural applications. Same-day and after-hours service are available.

Mountain Drivetrain serves customers in off-road, light- and heavy-duty truck, marine, oilfield, agricultural, semi-truck, and heavy-equipment industries. Its clientele includes individual truck owners, marine operators, agricultural businesses, and industrial fleets. Testimonials reference customers from Lander, Thermopolis, and the surrounding Wyoming area.

The company emphasizes friendly service, quality workmanship, and fast turn-around to retain customers. Its owner-operated model and extensive parts inventory enable same-day repairs and custom fabrication without long lead times.

name: Mountain High Woodworks Inc.
old_description: CUSTOM CABINETS. CUSTOM DOORS. CUSTOM FURNITURE. CUSTOM MILLWORK. CUSTOM WOODWORKING. CUSTOM CABINETRY DESIGN AND ENGINEERING. CUSTOM CNC PROJECTS.
about:
Mountain High Woodworks was founded in 1980 in the Bridger Mountains near Bozeman, Montana. The company remains based in Bozeman, where it operates a full-service woodworking shop.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, furniture, millwork, and doors, blending state-of-the-art CNC machining with traditional hand carving. In-house capabilities extend to custom metal blacksmithing, leaded hand-blown glass, ironwork, and leather detailing. Design engineers create CAD shop drawings for client approval, and the finish department develops custom finishes on sample pieces before full production. All manufacturing occurs at the Bozeman facility.

The firm serves architects, builders, and interior designers across the Mountain West and beyond, with projects completed in Montana, Wyoming, Idaho, Utah, Colorado, Arizona, Ohio, Nevada, California, Alaska, Canada, Mexico, South Korea, and Quebec. Clients range from owners of small custom cabins to large luxury residences, and the portfolio includes specialty spaces such as gun rooms, fly-fishing rooms, trophy rooms, saloon bars, wine cellars, smoking rooms, and home theaters.

Mountain High Woodworks emphasizes a complete custom-shop experience, from concept through installation. The company highlights its combination of advanced CNC technology and hand craftsmanship, the ability to integrate diverse materials, and a team of seasoned installers who ensure the final fit matches the design intent.

name: Mrs Clark's Foods
old_description: We partner with global and regional brands to deliver innovative food and beverage solutions of the highest quality, meeting today’s needs and anticipating tomorrow’s.
about:
Mrs. Clark's Foods operates from Ankeny, Iowa, where it was founded in 1926 by Mary Clark as a small mayonnaise supplier to local grocery chains. Over nearly a century, the company has expanded its portfolio to include juices, salad dressings, and a full range of condiments while remaining rooted in its original Midwestern location.

The company runs dedicated manufacturing facilities focused on hot-fill juice, cold-fill BBQ sauce, and emulsified products such as mayonnaise and dressings. Its 200,000-square-foot warehouse supports dry, refrigerated, and frozen storage, and the operation produced 4.5 million cases in the most recent year with a reported 97 percent yield and 99.7 percent forecasted fulfillment.

Mrs. Clark's serves global and regional brands across consumer retail, private label, co-manufacturing, and food-service channels. Customers engage the company for turnkey co-packing, white-label production, formulation development, and national-brand-equivalent matching, with packaging options ranging from single-serve cups and sachets to bulk pails, drums, and totes.

The business emphasizes a quality heritage and operational consistency, citing pillars such as 'A Higher Bar' and 'Consistency to Grow' alongside a delivery radius of one day within 600 miles and two days within 1,200 miles. Its stated mission is to partner with brands on innovative food and beverage solutions that meet current needs and anticipate future demand.
